verdicts.reason: A breaks the design: the orange overlay is an empty rectangle off to the right, the frame lines are gone, the copy order is scrambled (the tickets line sits above 'Richmond High School Theatre Presents'), small white text sits on a busy dark photo, and the play icon is blown up and stranded in the bottom-left corner. B keeps the framed structure, hierarchy and reading order intact, but it is just the portrait poster dropped into a centre column with untinted dark photo bars on either side (a shrunk copy, not a reflow), and the secondary text and play icon are very small.
